# asc_security_rule (Resource)

Manages a Security Rule within a Security Group in the ASC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a Security Group first
resource "asc_security_group" "example" {
  name = "db-access"
}

# Add an egress rule allowing TCP traffic to a CIDR block
resource "asc_security_rule" "allow_db_egress" {
  security_group_name = asc_security_group.example.name
  direction           = "egress"

  ports {
    protocol = "TCP"
    port     = 5432
  }

  peers {
    ip_block {
      cidr   = "10.0.0.0/24"
      except = ["10.0.0.1/32"]
    }
  }
}

# Add an ingress rule allowing traffic from specific pods
resource "asc_security_rule" "allow_app_ingress" {
  security_group_name = asc_security_group.example.name
  direction           = "ingress"

  ports {
    protocol = "TCP"
    port     = 8080
  }

  peers {
    pod_selector = {
      app = "frontend"
    }
  }
}

# Output the rule details
output "egress_rule_id" {
  description = "The ID of the egress rule"
  value       = asc_security_rule.allow_db_egress.id
}

output "ingress_rule_id" {
  description = "The ID of the ingress rule"
  value       = asc_security_rule.allow_app_ingress.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `direction` (String) The rule direction: "ingress" or "egress".
- `security_group_name` (String) The name of the parent security group.

### Optional

- `peers` (Attributes List) Peers (sources for ingress, destinations for egress) for this rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--peers))
- `ports` (Attributes List) Ports allowed by this rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the security rule (security_group_name:direction:index).
- `index` (Number) The 0-based index of the rule within the direction (assigned by the API).

<a id="nestedatt--peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `peers`

Optional:

- `ip_block` (Attributes) Selects a CIDR range and optional exceptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--peers--ip_block))
- `namespace_selector` (Map of String) Selects namespaces by label.
- `pod_selector` (Map of String) Selects pods by label within the same namespace.

<a id="nestedatt--peers--ip_block"></a>
### Nested Schema for `peers.ip_block`

Required:

- `cidr` (String) The IP range in CIDR notation (e.g. "10.0.0.0/24").

Optional:

- `except` (List of String) CIDRs to exclude from the range.



<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `port` (Number) The port number (1-65535).
- `protocol` (String) The network protocol (TCP, UDP, or SCTP).
